verdict.text: Verdict: not separated / conflict. CF-107 stays open, no switch changes, and the result is not evidence against C1. D1 is conditional on the Gigl ceiling (Ea_decay_thiol_sink binds at 102 kJ/mol in a rival). Supply is credited on the reservoir block only; a D1 gain of C1 is 'consistent with supply, not attributed' (C2 / R2 not run, sec. 5.1). The reservoir block is one pot from one laboratory (Zhang 2025b, BTBU) whose Cys and Xyl print one identical ELSD calibration curve (CF-063): 'both units' is close to one datum, so any supply credit rests on Zhang 2025b alone.
